title: Building to Understand: Examining Teens’ Technical and Socio-Ethical Pieces of Understandings in the Construction of Small Generative Language Models
reasoning: The paper's core research question focuses on identifying 'socio-ethical pieces of understanding' in teenagers. It explicitly categorizes and analyzes their reasoning around responsibility, harm, discrimination (SE10), and ethical dilemmas using tools like 'ethical matrices' and 'ethical cards.' This makes ethical and moral evaluation of the technology a central component of the study.
